capture: Original FLEX Capture popup bundle and stylesheet, rendered in an isolated iframe with demonstration connection data. Browser frame and mosaic are presentation artwork, not the Pexels website.

drag_animation.source: Real single-file FLEX Capture UI: drop target, redesigned Save to Studio, virtual folder picker, saving notification and completed notification. Transfer responses in the capture fixture are simulated; UI states and button actions use the actual components. Cursor and thumbnail movement are presentation layers.
drag_animation.reference: Eagle drag gesture studied for sequencing and timing. No Eagle image, interface, logo or video is included.
drag_animation.motion: Continuous quintic cursor path; one panel outline with interpolated bounds; no full-frame crossfades. Actual rendered UI captures provide contents.

batch_animation.data: Isolated documentation fixtures. No live upload or production data changes.
batch_animation.motion: Cursor to Save, pending state, horizontal library reveal and return. Identical source loop endpoints.
batch_animation.playback: Only the active visible slide plays. Paused offscreen, in hidden tabs and for reduced motion.

screenshot_animation.source: The selection uses the extension pointer handler. The focus mask and handles are styled for the documentation artwork.

right_click_animation.source: Recreated browser context menu showing the FLEX Capture action over the source photo.
